# fleetlens-ingest workspace

fleetlens-ingest pulls telemetry batches from vehicle gateways and lands them in the shard
store. Each ingest worker owns one shard.

logs/fleetlens-ingest.log is the ingest tier's application log for 2026-01-19. One record per
line:

    <RFC3339 UTC timestamp> <level> <component> shard=<nn> device=<id> points=<n> dur_ms=<n> call=<id>

The call field carries the identifier of the ingress call the record belongs to, so a gateway
retry shares the identifier of the first attempt. Levels run INFO / WARN / ERROR / FATAL; a
FATAL record means the worker stopped and its shard has to be repaired before it accepts
batches again.

# fleetlens ingest on-call runbook

- Dashboards: Grafana folder "fleetlens" (ingest rate, shard health, gateway retries).
- Escalation: telemetry-platform rota, PagerDuty service "fleetlens-primary".
- A FATAL record is a page: the shard named on that record stops accepting batches.
- Nightly shard compaction runs at 02:30 UTC from the maintenance controller, not this tier.

turns.prompt: The fleetlens ingest tier appends one record per batch to logs/fleetlens-ingest.log. A shift review needs the ingress call attached to the FATAL record. Report that call identifier. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
